title: Exploring Language Patterns of Prompts in Text-to-Image Generation and Their Impact on Visual Diversity

bias_targets.methodology: Quantifying the visual diversity of AI-generated images using Vendi Scores and correlating these scores with lexical diversity metrics (e.g., Type-Token Ratio, Self-Repetition Score, Compression Ratios) and semantic similarity of user prompts to show how linguistic repetition reduces visual variety.

Qualitative visual analysis of outputs generated from highly similar and popular prompt clusters to identify default subject representations, specifically observing the overrepresentation of young, female, and light-skinned subjects with blue eyes even when not specified in the prompt.
